1/ Cash Flow Brief, Nov 13 ☀️

Nvidia's CEO exit, a key inflation report at 8:30 AM and Bitcoin under $70,000 are the big items for your wallet today.

What happened, why it matters, and what could happen next 🧵

2/ Politics: Iran says it hit a US radar in Bahrain, unconfirmed. Senate Banking wants Huang to testify Dec. 3, Lutnick Dec. 10.

Why it matters: Gulf tension can lift oil and gas prices.

Next: If strikes continue, energy costs may stay high. Watch Qatar talks.

3/ Economy: US PPI at 8:30 AM, forecast 0.4% vs 1.3% before. France's October inflation hit 3.7%.

Why it matters: Producer costs can feed into prices you pay.

Next: If PPI beats forecast, rate-hike bets may grow. Watch the 8:30 print.

4/ Stocks: Thursday, Nvidia fell 4.3% after CEO Jensen Huang resigned. AMD rose 5.9%. Nebius fell about 17%.

Why it matters: AI stocks sit in many index funds and 401(k)s.

Next: Nvidia reports Nov 17, timing unconfirmed. Watch its guidance.

5/ Bitcoin broke below $70,000, first time since August. Long liquidations: $1.2B to $1.65B. Why it matters: Macro, not crypto news, drives it. Next: Hot inflation could add pressure. Watch Nov 30 MSCI removal of Strategy. Not financial advice.
